title: 5 years and counting!
author: TheKing.Zay
text:
Tried again and it’s still an unorganized mess.

Update: Just cancelled my subscription. Not giving any more money when feedback is being ignored across all Google products. 

4 years and still no fix…
There’s still no slider for recently added, only on the default homepage, which makes photos and videos I save from social media end up out of order. The slider on recently added only scrolls a little at a time compared to the defualt page being able to jump months or years. On iPhone the video player is buggy too. The play button keeps showing on loops and they stutter instead of playing smooth. Android finally got the slider back but iPhone is still waiting. I already back everything up with another service, but it’s frustrating that Google ignores feedback. It’s been years with no simple improvements. Same with YouTube Music. No quick scroll in long playlists and no way to search songs inside a playlist. These are basic features that should’ve been here by now 🤷‍♂️

title: Can’t sync photos anymore
author: Ajay Gautam
text:
Google Photos app on iPhone shows 736 photos for an album, but on the website shows only 84 photos.

No upload status is shown. 
No way to get help! “Help and feedback” just keeps going round and round in circles. 

Overall… Google tools are great when they work, and suck when they don’t . More and more though… I am finding that Google tools no longer work. And have no way to fix / contact support.
